details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept that beacons to a callback host at install time. Its package.json postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, and index.js fires the same beacon when the package is imported, so a build that resolves the name reports itself. The beacon sends a single HTTP POST to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with Content-Type application/json, the header X-Beacon-Package: @c1-ease/bank, and a JSON body containing only package name, os.hostname(), the install path (__dirname), process.cwd(), the npm/user-agent string and the protocol. It sets rejectUnauthorized:false to tolerate the callback host's self-signed certificate and suppresses its own errors and a 5s timeout so the install proceeds. The payload collects no credentials, tokens, environment values, wallet data or file contents, makes no second-stage download and performs no execution or persistence beyond the install beacon. index.js exports a no-op Proxy shim so that consumers importing the package do not crash. The README describes the package as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test that only reports that it was installed.
